notes:
Fixed the social mesh going permanently offline on some machines: the bundled VIBIN-Tailscale Windows service could end up stopped or disabled (debloat tools, interrupted updates, failed post-install start) and the launcher could never restart it without elevation — friends stayed at 0 forever until a reinstall.

What changed:
- Installer now always re-arms the service (demand start), grants start/stop rights to standard users, retries startup 3x and verifies it reached Running, and pins bundled Tailscale away from self-updates.
- The launcher starts/revives the service at runtime and a detached watchdog stops it when the launcher exits or crashes — Tailscale now lives and dies with the app.
- Diagnostics gains a one-click elevated service repair; health checks now report a missing/stopped/disabled service as a failure with a fix action; a red banner with a Fix button appears in the Friends tab when the mesh is down.
